what: a Corpse-Swallower, one of the brood of Hraesvelgr, the giant in the shape of an eagle who sits at the northern edge of heaven in Norse myth and makes the winds with his wings: a real eagle drawn enormous and ancient, with massive heavy proportions, a thick neck, a deep chest, a huge hooked beak, very broad wings with long fingered feathers at the tips and a fan tail. Its feathers are white and pale ash-grey all over, every feather crusted along its edge with white hoarfrost like frost on a window, the long flight feathers at the wing tips dark charcoal-grey. Its huge hooked beak is pale bone-white, the pale beak of the Voluspa's eagle. Its two eyes are pale icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, fierce and staring. A thin trail of white snow streams back from the tip of each wing, joined to the feathers.
colours: white and pale ash-grey feathers with white hoarfrost along every edge, dark charcoal-grey wing tips, a pale bone-white hooked beak, pale icy winter-sky eyes, dull grey scaly legs, black talons, thin white snow trails at the wing tips.
wears: It is a bird and wears nothing.
holds: It is a bird and holds nothing; both taloned feet are empty and open, the black talons spread.
pose: Seen from the side and a little from below, it stoops down to the left out of the sky, both great wings raised high and spread wide above its back, bent sharply at the wrist like two tall arches with the tips pointing down, its pale beak open in a scream, both feet thrust forward under its chest with the talons spread to strike, the whole bird wholly inside the picture.
must_show: a giant eagle with white and pale grey frost-crusted feathers
a pale bone-white hooked beak and icy blue eyes
great wings raised and spread, stooping to strike
talons spread forward, feet empty
must_not_show: white head on a brown body

what: a rime-thurs, one of the oldest frost giants of Norse myth, the line of Ymir who grew out of the rime: a huge, ancient, powerfully built giant man standing on two legs, older and grimmer than any frost giant, with realistic adult proportions, a small head, very broad shoulders, long thick limbs, about eight heads tall. His skin is cold slate-grey with a blue tinge, a colour no living man has, and it is crusted all over with thick white hoarfrost like a frozen pond, on his face, chest, arms and legs alike. His long beard and his long hair are not hair at all but hang in hundreds of thick white icicles. On his head is a crown of jagged blue-white ice. His two eyes are small and pale icy blue, glaring from under a heavy frost-white brow.
colours: cold slate-grey skin with a blue tinge, thick white hoarfrost crusting every part of him, a beard and hair of hanging white icicles, a jagged crown of blue-white ice, pale icy eyes, a loincloth and shoulder-wrap of dark grey wolf fur, a maul whose head is one great block of blue-white glacier ice on a long dark pine trunk.
wears: He wears only a loincloth and a shoulder-wrap of shaggy dark grey wolf fur, held by a cord of plaited dark leather. His chest, arms and legs are bare and frost-crusted. No metal, no armour, no helmet but the ice crown.
holds: He holds exactly one maul in both hands: a long straight trunk of dark pine wood as long as he is tall, with one huge rough block of blue-white glacier ice bound to its top end, the block as big as his own chest. Nothing else is in his hands.
pose: He strides to the left on two legs with one foot forward, both arms swinging the ice maul back over his right shoulder to strike, his icicle beard swinging, his jaw open in a roar, seen from the side and a little from the front.
must_show: a huge ancient giant with frost-crusted slate-grey skin
a beard and hair of white icicles and a crown of ice
dark grey wolf-fur loincloth and wrap, no armour
one maul: a pine trunk with a block of glacier ice on top, held in both hands
must_not_show: a club of clear ice held by its thin end
cloud of mist around the body

what: a kallikantzaros, the Christmas goblin of Greek folklore who spends the year under the earth sawing at the World Tree and climbs up through the chimneys for the twelve days of Christmas: a small, wiry, shaggy goblin about as tall as a child, standing on two legs. It is covered all over in long shaggy fur that is black with chimney soot, on its body, arms and legs alike. Its face is a goblin's face: a squashed snout, a wide grinning mouth with two yellowed tusks jutting up from the lower jaw, two small round eyes that glow bright red, and two long drooping ears like a donkey's. Below the knee its legs are the shaggy legs of a goat ending in black cloven hooves. Its fingers end in long, thick, curved grey nails as long as its hand. A thin tufted tail hangs behind it.
colours: shaggy fur black with chimney soot over every part, a smudged dark grey face, two small glowing bright red eyes, two yellowed tusks, long dull grey curved nails, black cloven hooves, a big crude saw with a dark iron blade and a dark wooden handle.
wears: It wears nothing but its own sooty fur.
holds: It holds exactly one saw in both hands: a big crude saw with a broad, heavy, dark iron blade as long as its own body, edged with big jagged teeth as big as its fingers, and a thick dark wooden handle at one end, held clear of its body. Nothing else is in its hands.
pose: Seen from the side and a little from the front, it scuttles forward to the left on its goat legs in a low crouch, both arms swinging the big saw up and forward as if to bite into a tree trunk, mouth open in a grin, red eyes wide.
must_show: a small shaggy goblin black with soot, about a child's height
glowing red eyes, yellow tusks, long donkey ears
goat legs with black cloven hooves, long grey nails
one big crude toothed saw in both hands

what: an oni, one of the horned jailers of the Buddhist hells of Japan, painted like an oni of an old Japanese scroll brought to life: a huge, powerful, heavy-shouldered demon, plainly a monster and never a man, with realistic adult proportions, a small head, long thick arms, two arms, standing on two legs. His skin is bright vermilion red on his face, chest, arms and legs alike, a colour no living man has. His head is an oni's: a broad heavy face with a wide snarling mouth full of fangs, two big white fangs curving up from the lower jaw, a big flat nose, a heavy frowning brow, two round bulging yellow eyes, a wild shock of black hair, and two short thick curved horns of yellowed ivory rising from his brow. His fingers end in short black claws.
colours: bright vermilion red skin, a wild shock of black hair, two yellowed ivory horns, white fangs, round bulging yellow eyes, a loincloth of real tiger skin, bright orange fur with bold black stripes, a club of dark black iron covered in round iron studs.
wears: Round his waist he wears only a short loincloth made from a real tiger's pelt: bright orange fur with bold black stripes. His chest, arms and legs are bare. No armour, no helmet, no robe, no jewels.
holds: He holds exactly one club in his right hand, raised high over his head: the iron kanabo, one long straight thick club of dark black iron as long as his arm and leg together, narrow at the grip and swelling to a heavy end covered all over in rows of round iron studs, nothing sticking out sideways. His left hand is an empty open claw reaching forward.
pose: He charges forward to the left on two legs, seen from the side and a little from the front, one knee driving up, his right arm swinging the iron club up over his head to smash down, his left claw reaching out, his fanged mouth open in a roar.
must_show: a huge bright red-skinned demon with two short horns
a fanged snarling face with bulging yellow eyes and wild black hair
a tiger-skin loincloth, orange with black stripes
one long studded iron club raised in the right hand
must_not_show: a mask held in the hand

what: a mushmahhu, the Exalted Serpent with seven heads, one of the eleven monsters Tiamat made to fight the gods in the Babylonian creation epic, painted like a creature from an old Babylonian cylinder seal brought to life: one great serpent and nothing but a serpent. Its body is one single thick snake's body lying in a heavy coil, and from the top of that coil seven snake necks rise and spread apart like the ribs of an open fan, with backdrop showing between them, each neck ending in its own snake's head. Each head is a viper's head, broad and flat, with one short curved horn of dark bronze above each eye, glossy black eyes, and open jaws with long white fangs dripping thick yellow venom. Its scales are dark bronze-green like old bronze gone green, banded with broad black rings, with a pale dull gold belly.
colours: dark bronze-green scales banded with broad black rings, a pale dull gold belly and throat, short dark bronze horns, glossy black eyes, long white fangs, drops of thick yellow venom.
pose: The coiled body lies heavy in the lower middle of the picture, its tail tip curling out at the right, and the seven necks rise from it and spread like an open fan, the middle head lifted highest and striking toward the viewer, the heads to its left leaning out to the left and the heads to its right leaning out to the right, every mouth open, the whole serpent wholly inside the picture.
must_show: one coiled serpent with seven snake heads on seven necks spread like a fan
dark bronze-green scales with broad black bands
a short horn above each eye, jaws open, venom dripping
no legs, no wings

what: a nine-tailed fox, the kyubi no kitsune of Japanese legend that became the lady Tamamo-no-Mae: a real fox on four legs, seen from the side, lean, graceful and larger than a wolf, with a narrow pointed muzzle, tall pointed ears and a long body. Its fur is cream-white and pale gold, with bold thin crimson markings painted on its face round the eyes and up the ears like the mask of a shrine fox. Its two eyes are narrow, slanted and bright gold. From the base of its back nine long full fox tails rise and spread out behind and above it like a great fan of white and gold plumes, each tail with backdrop showing round it, and at the tip of each tail burns one small orange-gold flame, joined to the fur.
colours: cream-white and pale gold fur, thin crimson markings round the eyes and on the ears, narrow bright gold eyes, a black nose, nine cream-white tails, small orange-gold flames at the tail tips.
wears: It is a fox and wears nothing.
holds: It is a fox and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it stands on all four legs facing left, its front paws together and its head turned to look back at the viewer over its shoulder, its nine tails raised and spread in a fan above and behind it, its mouth a little open in a knowing smile.
must_show: a real cream-white and gold fox on four legs
nine long tails spread in a fan, small flames at their tips
crimson markings on the face, narrow gold eyes
seen from the side
must_not_show: a mask held in the paws

what: Geryon, the monster of fraud from Dante's Inferno, painted like an engraving of the Inferno brought to life. It has the head of a human man: the kind, calm, honest face of a grey-bearded old judge turned toward the viewer, with a straight nose, gentle eyes, a closed mouth, full lips and a neatly trimmed grey beard, a man's head and never a lion's or a dragon's. Below the head and neck, his body is the long thick body of a serpent, with no human arms and no human legs: for the length of a man's torso it stands straight up under the head like a pillar, then it curves down and lies in a heavy coil. Two forelimbs grow from the front of the serpent body where a man's shoulders would be: two thick hairy paws like a lion's, furred all the way to the armpits, with big black claws. The serpent's hide is painted all over with knots and wheels in bold patterns. The serpent's tail is a scorpion's: from the end of the coil it rises high over the back, jointed and black, and ends in a forked sting of two curved black needle-points.
colours: a kind face of weather-beaten light tan skin and a neat grey beard, a serpent hide of tawny gold painted all over with bold knots and wheels of deep crimson and dark blue edged in black, two shaggy dark brown furred paws with black claws, a glossy black jointed scorpion tail and a forked black sting.
wears: He wears nothing; the knots and wheels are the colours of his own hide.
holds: He holds nothing; both furred paws are open, the black claws spread.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from the side, the serpent body rears straight up so the kind face looks calmly at the viewer, both hairy paws reaching forward, while the coil lies heavy below and the black scorpion tail arches high over his back with the forked sting poised to strike forward over his shoulder, the whole creature wholly inside the picture.
must_show: the calm kind face of a grey-bearded old man on a serpent's body
a serpent hide painted with bold knots and wheels
two hairy lion's paws for arms, no human arms
a black scorpion tail ending in a forked sting

what: Viy, the chief of the gnomes from Gogol's Ukrainian tale, whose eyelids hang down to the ground: a squat, hunched, broad creature standing on two short thick legs, nearly as wide as it is tall, its small head sunk between heavy shoulders, plainly a monster and never a man. Its whole body is caked in black earth and clay, and its arms and legs are knotted and twisted like the roots of an old oak torn out of the ground, ending in long root-like fingers and toes. Its face is a flat dark iron mask, the colour of an old iron nail, set into the earth of its head, with a long iron nose and a hard iron mouth. Its two eyelids are enormous flaps of dark grey hide hanging from its iron brow down over its chest to its knees like heavy curtains, and they are lifted just a little at the top, so that under them shows one narrow slit of burning amber light where its eyes are.
colours: black earth and dark brown clay caking every part of it, knotted dark brown root arms and legs, a flat dark iron face the colour of an old iron nail, two huge flaps of dark grey hide for eyelids, a narrow slit of burning amber light under the lids.
wears: It wears nothing but the black earth caked on it.
holds: It holds nothing; its long root fingers are spread open and reaching.
pose: Seen from the front, it lurches heavily forward toward the viewer on its short root legs, its two root arms reaching out to seize, its iron face lifted, the heavy eyelids hanging down its front with the slit of burning light just showing under them.
must_show: a squat hunched creature caked in black earth, with root-like arms and legs
a flat dark iron face
two huge eyelids hanging down to its knees
a narrow slit of burning amber light under the lids

what: the Image of the Beast from the Book of Revelation, the idol given breath to speak: a made thing, a towering idol cast in gold in the shape of a monstrous beast, plainly metal and never flesh, like a suit of armour in the shape of a beast with big cast plates and dark gaps between them. Its body is a great leopard's body cast in gold, standing up on its two hind legs, which are the heavy feet of a bear. It has three heads on three thick necks springing from its shoulders and spreading apart like the ribs of an open fan, with backdrop showing between them: each head is a lion's head cast in gold, with its mouth wide open as if speaking, and each wears a small spiked golden crown. Every head has two short golden horns. Its eyes are empty black holes. Fine golden spots like a leopard's rosettes are engraved all over its body.
colours: polished deep gold metal over every part, hard white glints on every curve and edge, dark brown-black shadows in the seams between the cast plates, engraved rosettes, empty black eye-holes, open mouths that are black inside, small spiked golden crowns.
wears: It wears only its three small spiked golden crowns, cast as part of it.
holds: It holds nothing; its two golden forepaws are raised and open, the golden claws spread.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from the side, it rears up on its bear's hind legs toward the viewer, both golden forepaws raised to strike, its three heads spread like a fan, the middle head highest, every mouth open wide, the whole idol wholly inside the picture with nothing under its feet.
must_show: a beast cast wholly in gold metal, plainly a made idol
three crowned lion heads spread like a fan, mouths open
a leopard's body standing on bear's hind legs
hard metal glints and dark seams between cast plates
